subject: Golden-hour rotation handoff: US/EU/APAC deep-dive windows
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@optimahealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Golden-hour rotation handoff: US/EU/APAC deep-dive windows

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for confirming the POC kickoff next week. To make the hands-on sessions useful for your engineering and ops teams across APAC, EU, and US, we want to propose a lightweight "golden-hour" rotation model so each region gets at least one overlap window with Redwood subject-matter experts.

Attached is a simple rotation grid (POC-rotation-grid.xlsx) with proposed 90-minute slots over the first two days of the POC:
- Day 1: Prompt review + routing sanity checks
- Day 2: Load rehearsal + KV-cache warmup and failover drills

Can you confirm the following so we can lock invites?
1) Which of these 90-minute windows works for your team (I put TZ conversions on the grid).
2) Who at OptimaHealth should own the prompt review session — engineering or product?
3) Any hard constraints for the evening/night slots (we can avoid local night for your on-call).

If useful, we can rotate the order (APAC-first vs US-first) across days so nobody is on the late-night shift twice. Once we get availability, we’ll create calendar invites and assign leads for routing and load testing.

Attachments: POC-rotation-grid.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
[karthik.iyer@redwood.com]

From: Sara Nguyen <sara@optimahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Luke Price <luke.price@itops.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:01:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Golden-hour rotation handoff: US/EU/APAC deep-dive windows

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the grid. This looks promising and mirrors what we'd hoped for. A few notes from our side:
- We prefer APAC-first on Day 1 if possible (our product owner is in Singapore and it's critical she joins the prompt review).
- For prompt review ownership: product (Sara/ng) will cover high-level acceptance criteria; engineering (Luke) will own verification and triage items.
- Evening slots are tricky for our legal/infosec reviewers; can we avoid 22:00+ local for EU folks?

I attached a short availability snippet from our side — we can do the 90-minute window on:
- Tue 2026-09-07 23:00 SGT / 16:00 CET / 10:00 PDT (APAC-first option)
- Wed 2026-09-08 08:00 SGT / 01:00 CET / 18:00 PDT (less ideal for EU)

If those map to what you proposed, go ahead and draft invites and indicate who will drive the load test.

Thanks,
Sara Nguyen
Head of Product Operations | OptimaHealth
sara@optimahealth.com

Team —

Forwarding Sara's availability. OptimaHealth prefers APAC-first on Day 1 (prompt review) and wants to avoid late-night EU legal reviews. Can we converge on the APAC-first slot on Tue 2026-09-07 (90 minutes) and then run the load rehearsal on Day 2 with a US-first / EU overlap?

Proposed immediate actions:
- Lauren: can you own calendar invites and include the rotation grid? Use the APAC-first option for Tue 9/7. (I added a tentative calendar link in related_links.)
- Marissa: please take lead on prompt review facilitation and coordinate pre-read. I'll send a short prompt-review-notes.pdf with sample prompts and acceptance criteria by EOD.
- Ben: you're the load test owner — can you confirm you have the test harness and a failover plan ready for Wed 9/8? We want a KV-cache warmup and a short 10-minute failover exercise in the middle of the run.
- Irene: can you validate that our VPC peering checklist and bastion access instructions are in the invite so OptimaHealth's infra team can pre-check connectivity?

I attached a draft of the prompt-review notes and the rotation grid. I'll wait for confirmations and then Lauren can send the invites to OptimaHealth with the roles/owners in the description.

Attachments: prompt-review-notes.pdf; POC-rotation-grid.xlsx

- Wed 2026-09-08 17:00–19:00 PDT / 00:00–02:00 CET / 08:00–10:00 SGT — Load rehearsal + failover drills (US-first)

Calendar invites include: agenda, owners (Marissa = prompt review; Ben = load test), the rotation grid, and a connectivity checklist. Please check the invite description for the bastion instruk (summary) and a link to our pre-read folder.
